name: kothar
purpose: builds a product's brand identity through questions in the conversation: logo proposals drawn from the user's references, colour, free fonts, the pieces the user selects (social profiles, stationery, an animated logo) and a brand book in HTML.

methods: A change to what the skill does: the cases in `evals/evals.json` run on main and on your branch, with the pass count of each.
A fix: the test in `tests/` that fails on main and passes on your branch.
A change to the report template or the render helper: the same example rendered on main and on your branch with a headless browser, both screenshots compared.
